C1006.title: Report on Uzi's Ranked Matches Targeted by 'Actor' Groups
C1006.summary: In December 2021, media reported that League of Legends streamer Uzi was targeted by 'actor' and organized boosting groups in high-elo Korean server ranked matches. The report cited an exposed manipulation chart and said some accounts repeatedly matched with Uzi, intentionally lost games, and reportedly earned about 20,000 yuan in two hours. The case reflects organized manipulation of ranked matches involving high-traffic streamers.
